newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares climb to new record,more gains ahead.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares climb to new record,more gains ahead.

text.p: The top-20 KFX Copenhagen share index finished on Tuesday at a new all-time record closing high for the second consecutive day and dealers saw no reason why further advances could not continue.
"We could well see the index climb another point tomorrow. Institutional investors are focusing on liquid paper and private investors on more speculative sideline shares," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index ended the day 0.95 point higher at 143.39, a new record closing high while the KFX March future rose 2.85 point to 143.85 with 50 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
The day's most traded paper was East Asiatic with 400,000 shares changing hands to close two crowns higher at 147.
Den Danske Bank put on six crowns to close at 496, while rival Unidanmark outdid that to finish nine crowns higher at 346.
Moeller shipping and oil shares bucked the generally positive trend with D/S 1912 and D/S Svendborg shedding 2,000 and 1,318 crowns respectively to finish at 177,000 and 253,682.
Overall turnover for the day was 1.850 billion crowns.
